description: Revert to the proven 2^19 global batch size to maximize gradient steps and the 0.033 Muon learning rate for stability, while increasing model depth to 10 (and dimensions to 640) to improve model capacity, as the previous best result (0.9830) suggests the model was under-parameterized rather than unstable, and the 76GB VRAM on H200 can accommodate the slightly larger model with the high-throughput configuration.
